anna_docs: FYI I opened a concise PR to address three small but recurring docs issues in the Optimize toolkit: (1) quant profile name mapping, (2) two SDK snippet variants (latency vs throughput), (3) fix a short-sequence example that regressed. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3512

devbot: PR #3512 opened by anna_docs  labels: docs,optkit,quickfix

sanjay_opt: Thanks. Quick question: are we changing any runtime defaults? customers must not get surprises.

anna_docs: No runtime changes. Docs only. I added a clear "No runtime change" callout and a compatibility table showing legacy -> aliased names (e.g., q8_0 -> q8_0_compat).

mike_eng: Snippets look good. Suggest adding a one-liner about streaming interactions with KV prefetch (can increase first-token latency).

anna_docs: Added under "Notes on prefetch": "KV prefetch improves throughput for long sequences but can raise cold-start p50 for streaming/short-turn flows; consider disabling prefetch for seq < 48." Also added two snippets:
```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
# latency-focused
c = OptimizeClient()
c.configure(batch_size=1, prefetch_kv=False, quant_profile='q8_0_compat')
# throughput-focused
c.configure(batch_size=64, prefetch_kv=True, quant_profile='q8_0_compat')
```

lisa_pm: tiny product ask: update step that links to Console to point at /console/telemetry and note rollout behavior respects aliases. left an inline comment.
devbot: staging build started  preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optkit/migration

devbot: CI: docs-lint  pass, link-check  fail (1 broken Console link)

anna_docs: fixed Console link, rebased, pushed. local smoke logs pasted: "[smoke] latency seq=16 p50=32ms; throughput seq=256 p50=120ms". Ready to merge after one LGTM.

mike_eng: LGTM from eng.

lisa_pm: LGTM from product once CI green. Add a release-note one-liner.

anna_docs: CI green. Merging now and will add release note + ping support channel to watch for any migration questions. :tada:
